INSCRIPTION: Through me the way is to the city dolent;
Through me the way is to eternal dole;
Through me the way among the people lost.
The highest Wisdom and the primal Love.
Before me there were no created things,
Only eterne, and I eternal last.
All hope abandon, ye who enter in!

darkwood.title: The Dark Wood
lines: Midway upon the journey of our life
I found myself within a forest dark,
For the straightforward pathway had been lost.

vestibule.title: The Vestibule
vestibule.who: those who lived without infamy or praise
lines: There sighs, complaints, and ululations loud
Resounded through the air without a star,

acheron.title: Acheron
lines: “Woe unto you, ye souls depraved!
Hope nevermore to look upon the heavens;

limbo.title: The First Circle · Limbo
limbo.who: the unbaptized, and the great of the old world
lines: Lost are we and are only so far punished,
That without hope we live on in desire.”

lustful.title: The Second Circle
lustful.who: the lustful, driven on the wind
lines: I came into a place mute of all light,
Which bellows as the sea does in a tempest,

gluttons.title: The Third Circle
lines: In the third circle am I of the rain
Eternal, maledict, and cold, and heavy;

avaricious.title: The Fourth Circle
lines: Crying, “Why keepest?” and, “Why squanderest thou?”

styx.title: The Fifth Circle · Styx
styx.who: the wrathful, and under the water the sullen
lines: A marsh it makes, which has the name of Styx,
This tristful brooklet, when it has descended

heretics.title: The Sixth Circle · the City of Dis
lines: For flames between the sepulchres were scattered,
By which they so intensely heated were,

blood.title: The Seventh Circle · Phlegethon
lines: The river of blood, within which boiling is
Whoe’er by violence doth injure others.”

wood.title: The Seventh Circle · the Wood
lines: Not foliage green, but of a dusky colour,
Not branches smooth, but gnarled and intertangled,
Not apple-trees were there, but thorns with poison.

sand.title: The Seventh Circle · the Burning Sand
sand.who: the violent against God, nature and art
lines: O’er all the sand-waste, with a gradual fall,
Were raining down dilated flakes of fire,
As of the snow on Alp without a wind.

brink.title: The Great Cliff
lines: Thus downward from a bank precipitate,
We found resounding that dark-tinted water,

malebolge.title: The Eighth Circle · Malebolge
lines: There is a place in Hell called Malebolge,
Wholly of stone and of an iron colour,

well.title: The Well of the Giants
lines: “Raphael mai amech izabi almi,”
Began to clamour the ferocious mouth,

cocytus.title: The Ninth Circle · Cocytus
lines: And underfoot a lake, that from the frost
The semblance had of glass, and not of water.

SAID.fall: And fell, even as a dead body falls.
round: Thou hast not yet through all the circle turned.
charon: Thou to the shore shalt come, not here, for passage;
dis: The city draweth near whose name is Dis,
With the grave citizens, with the great throng.”
SAID.geryon: “Behold the monster with the pointed tail,
lucifer: The Emperor of the kingdom dolorous
SAID.stars: Thence we came forth to rebehold the stars.
